name: (2025 EVENT!) Silly RPG!
desc:
(TW: Loud Sounds, Flashing Lights, and Bright Colors. Private Servers are free if you want to avoid multiplayer lag!) 

Welcome to the Land of Sillies! Your objective is to find the Gods and try to stop them from planning further to destroy your planet! Travel through many lands and adventures! Buy Weapons and Buffs to help you progress further as you find out what's truly happening, as well as to find many hidden secrets! Bugs can be found as this game is in Beta, join the Social Links below to help us fix the bugs! Macro Usage is allowed but Exploiting isn't. 

As further stated, the game isn't finished. So, bugs can be found easily. Game will only shutdown when there is a Major Update or a Small/Major Bug Fix. This game is a Small Project so don't expect us to Release Major Updates That Often. (Exploiting = Permanent Blacklist.)
